releases.notes:
# Added

- Share button: Share an advancement in chat. The message has a clickable link that opens that advancement in the mod's screen.
- Escape menu: The "Advancements" button in the pause menu now opens this mod's screen instead of the vanilla one.

# Improved

- Search: The search bar now also matches the description and the criteria, not only the title. Still case-insensitive.
- L key: Pressing the advancements key (L by default, rebinding is respected) now closes the screen.

# Fixed

- Theme colors: Every theme now has its own favorite color. It no longer uses the vanilla color and is different from the selected-tab color.
- Other small color inconsistencies in the themes.

# Notes

- The share link only works for players who also have the mod installed.
